details.description: Third party came to the rig with out proper ppe on
Making sure everybody wears there face shield while pressure washing

red_flags: On pace for ~1 assessments this month (target: 6)

recent_findings.concern: Tongs leaking my and one issue with hand placement while handling elevators.
recent_findings.positive: Great communication and handover by the crew whenaiing relief. Very thorough. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: SSE needs to do a better job of staying with his mentor and vice versa. I discussed this with them. As far as body positioning, hand placement and pinch points I didn't note any issues.
recent_findings.positive: Mike Gonzalez held a very thorough safety meeting covering all necessary tasks and requirements for the casing run. He made the rig crew aware of our SSE and his length of time and experience in the oilfield. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: As stated above, I noticed a crew member not stepping back out of the swing radius of the tongs after they were pulled onto the casing. I also observed crew members wearing hoodies. Had a discussion with them about Butch's policy for hoodies.
recent_findings.positive: Crew members were taking the time between connections to pressure wash and clean the floor and equipment while joints were drilled down. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Good JSA and proper communication and hand signals. Good consistent use of skiropes during the casing run

recent_findings.concern: Must consistently utilize skiropes while handling tongs
recent_findings.positive: Good communication and proper use of PPE

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: 3 man rig floor utilizing skiropes and good hand signal and communication with the driller and skate operator

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Crew taking adequate time to perform job safely.

recent_findings.concern: Crew members were constantly coaching up the SSE
recent_findings.positive: Crew members doping the pipe prior to the job starting

recent_findings.concern: Only unsafe behavior I observed today was by the thread rep not taking the time to walk around to get to the stump. We discussed the hazards of walking under the tongs and across hydraulic hoses.
recent_findings.positive: Crew was doing a great job explain everything to the SSE and monitoring him to be sure he was doing things correctly.

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Excellent communication, teamwork, hand and body placement throughout the take. The crew operated as a well oiled machine. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: While running casing observed a hand place his fingers inside the casing while removing the nubbin. The hand was advised to never place your fingers inside the casing to remove a nubbin always use your palms or the nubbin rod to remove it.

recent_findings.positive: Proper lifting techniques while pulling slips
Good work flow and proper communication with skate operator and driller

recent_findings.positive: Good communication between crew members. Good utilization of ski ropes on tongs while pulling them onto the casing and closing the door.

recent_findings.concern: Couple of hand placement concerns that were addressed on site.
recent_findings.positive: All equipment weighed up properly. Tools and extra equipment staged and orderly to the side of the rig floor.
